newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady as c.bank selling, client demand seen.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady as c.bank selling, client demand seen.

text.p: The rouble was little changed on Tuesday after central bank rouble sales over the previous few days but rouble demand from some major clients prevented the currency from weakening, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jun 17 midday Jun 17 early Jun 16 close
"Banks have sold many dollars to the central bank these days and roubles should have come to the market. But they did not because of bank clients seeking roubles," one dealer said.

Dealers said earlier Russia's natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom had been seeking funds to pay off taxes and its demand could support the rouble for more time despite the news it has already paid off its federal tax arrears.

A government spokesman said on Tuesday Gazprom has paid off all its federal tax arrears. He did not give any figures, while Energy Minister Boris Nemtsov had previously estimated its total debt at 14.8 trillion roubles ($2.57 billion).
"(Banks serving Gazprom) could get roubles through overnight credits and we could see dollar selling for longer," Most Bank dealer Andrei Tenyatov said.
